title: Zenith arc extension in Venezuela
text:
Massive displays are popping up regularly around South America, but on 20 November a true halo jewel was captured by Fray Caroly at Bachaquero, Venezuela. In her video the bright zenith arc is accompanied by its rare extension, traditionally called the Kern arc, though Dufay had reported it 160 years before Kern. Besides being the first zenith arc extension in Venezuela, South America and probably all of Latin America, the observation is remarkable because it was seen visually: the observer pans the camera to take it in. All earlier extensions in high cloud, about seven cases, were subvisual, brought out afterwards by photo processing.

If more recordings of the extension from this display turn up, they will be added to the display card.
